description:
Welcome to SafeNest Seniors — practical, no-nonsense home safety for seniors living independently, and for the families who love them.

Every week: simple countdowns of cheap, proven tricks (most under $20) that make your home a harder target — door security, scam-proofing, and everyday habits that add time and noise a burglar can't afford. No fear-mongering, no expensive gadgets. Just time-tested advice, including wisdom from retired cops and security pros.

⚠️ Disclaimer: This channel shares general home-safety information for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional security advice. Please use your judgment and consult local professionals for your situation.
